name: desktop-session-from-trixie-vmid132
goal: Make the AUZiX workstation behave like the known-good Trixie vmid132 desktop while preserving AUZiX path policy.

tiers.gate: boot, ssh/shell, base commands, auzix-pkg status/list
ldd/runtime scan and wrapper path export before menu visibility
DBus, Polkit, PAM, LightDM, Xorg input, runtime dirs
EFL/Efreet, Enlightenment, themes, icons, MIME, open-with, menu cache
small apps launch from exactly one sensible menu entry
LibreOffice, Flatpak apps, graphics/dev/control-panel apps pass CLI and GUI probes

requires_operator_before: broad compatibility alias changes at slash root

priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.name: Terminology or terminal fallback
priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.probe: launch terminal from E menu and run env, id, df, du, htop

priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.name: LibreOffice Calc/Writer/Impress/Draw
priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.probe: launch from menu and run CLI conversion smoke

priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.name: Flatpak Firefox or Opera
priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.probe: remote exists, install works, app launches without system-helper/dbus failure

priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.name: Midori
priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.probe: launch, render Google/Auzietek, no CA/font/sandbox crash

priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.name: Gnumeric, AbiWord, Geany, Leafpad, Ephoto
priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.probe: front-door menu launch plus ldd/runtime ladder

priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.name: Podman
priority_apps_for_filmable_desktop.probe: sudo podman ps, load AUZiX busybox/nginx image, serve page on local network
